item.title: Show HN: NinethirtyAI – A US equity research and analysis platform
item.summary: Hi HN - I'm Yashu and I've been building Ninethirty for a while. The problem: I do my own research, and a variety of tabs open for screening, charts, financials and so on; and then a chat window where I'd paste numbers for an LLM to reason and analyse them. We built NineThirty to solve a bunch of these problems - * A screener that goes deep and is genuinely customizable - fundamental, technical, news, and event criteria in the same query, not three separate tools. Besides, the problem does not end with screening - (almost) instantly backtest to understand historically what stocks have come up on the screen and their performance. * Company financials, sector views, heatmaps, events, seasonality, etc. the usual stuff * An AI assistant (Dr Market) that sits on top of this curated, processed data layer. Use it to validate a setup and it's working from the actual real time technical indicators, not a plausible-sounding reconstruction. This doesn't eliminate hallucinations. The hope is that when Dr. Market gets something wrong, it's interpreting the data badly rather than making up the data itself (or citing the wrong sources).
